finding: Videos cross-posted to Threads and X earn almost no organic reach; on Threads carousels did better than videos.

evidence.result: Threads video median exposure 5 (11 posts) against carousels 35 (4 posts); X video median 11.5 (10 posts), no shares.

revisit_when: Revisit when either account has more than a few hundred followers, or after a week of Threads carousels only.
